notes.title: Milestone Summer Sale
notes.notes:
Speed, Sunlight and Great Deals: these are the ingredients of the Milestone Summer Sale!

Check out our wide catalogue! You’ll find what you are looking for, whether you want to set a new lap record by riding a MotoGP prototype beast or join a two-wheel challenge on the bike you own in real life. If that’s not your vibe, you can jump into the mud and feel the adrenaline with our offroad games either taming a motocross motorcycle or driving a rally car!

Ain’t no summer without racing!

Click here to visit the sale page: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Milestone/sale/milestonesummersale]MILESTONE SUMMER SALE[/url]

notes.title: Monster Energy Supercross 3 – Patch Note #5
notes.notes:
Hi riders,

here we are, to share with you the latest updates introduced by this patch fixed the annoying reset of the online settings between races. Now you can focus more on just racing!

Other fixes

– Future add-ons support
– Minor changes on weather
– Minor fixes to customization items
– Minor UI fixes

notes.title: MONSTER ENERGY SUPERCROSS – THE OFFICIAL VIDEOGAME 3 NOW AVAILABLE.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36031530/d1e3763038c777f26d60e91d6636bece762c4637.gif[/img]

Monster Energy Supercross 3 is out! Get now your copy and enjoy the new features.
The latest chapter of the most beloved Supercross videogame is more realistic than ever!

Choose your rider from the Official Supercross Teams of the 2019 Championship; challenge your friends in the new lag-free multiplayer experience, thanks to the dedicated servers; create amazing online tournaments with the Race Director Mode; select a Female Custom Rider amongst different models; race alone or in co-op mode in a bigger and richer Compound; unleash your creativity with the track editor and feel the thrill of every whip, thanks to the improved physics and the new in-air bike control system.

What are you waiting for?
Watch the trailer, get your copy and… BE ONE OF US.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ypg_6Rw1eBE

notes.title: MONSTER ENERGY SUPERCROSS – THE OFFICIAL VIDEOGAME 3 - ANNOUNCEMENT.
notes.notes:
[b]Milestone[/b] and [b]Feld Entertainment[/b] announced in Las Vegas the new chapter of the official AMA Supercross Championship videogame series, during the Monster Energy Cup presentation for media and influencers at the Sam Boyd Stadium in Las Vegas. 

Milestone showcased an early build of Supercross3, inviting top riders to challenge each other with the live commentary of Ralph Shahen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36031530/5f304382c2540c4de5a779a0d0ed7e723b7b5b26.jpg[/img]

[b]MONSTER ENERGY SUPERCROSS – THE OFFICIAL VIDEOGAME 3,[/b] globally available on February 4th, will feature the 2019 Monster Energy Supercross season.

Get ready to show the whole world who’s the king of the hill!
